# wallix.bastion.user

Manage users on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete a user account on a WALLIX Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_user` Terraform resource.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-certificate-dn"></a>**certificate_dn** | `str` | Distinguished name of the X.509 certificate of the user. |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-display-name"></a>**display_name** | `str` | Display name of the user. |
| <a id="parameter-email"></a>**email** | `str` | Email address of the user.<br>Required when the user does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-expiration-date"></a>**expiration_date** | `str` | Expiration date of the account, in the format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`. Use `""` for no expiration. |
| <a id="parameter-force-change-pwd"></a>**force_change_pwd** | `bool` | Whether the user must change the password at the next login.<br>The Bastion resets it to `false` once the user has changed the password. |
| <a id="parameter-groups"></a>**groups** | `list / elements=str` | Names of the user groups the user belongs to. Order does not matter.<br>When set, replaces all the group memberships of the user. Use `[]` to remove the user from every group.<br>Group membership can also be managed from the group with [`wallix.bastion.usergroup`](usergroup.md) `users`; set it on one side only. |
| <a id="parameter-ip-source"></a>**ip_source** | `str` | IP addresses or networks the user may connect from, comma separated. Use `""` for no restriction. |
| <a id="parameter-is-disabled"></a>**is_disabled** | `bool` | Whether the account is disabled. |
| <a id="parameter-password"></a>**password** | `str` | Password of the user. Required by the Bastion when [`user_auths`](#parameter-user-auths) contains `local_password` and the user is created.<br>The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-preferred-language"></a>**preferred_language** | `str` | Language of the user interface for this user.<br><br>Choices: `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `ru` |
| <a id="parameter-profile"></a>**profile** | `str` | Name of the profile of the user, for example `user` or `product_administrator`.<br>Required when the user does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-ssh-public-key"></a>**ssh_public_key** | `str` | SSH public key of the user, used with the `local_sshkey` authentication method.<br>Several keys are given as one string with one key per line.<br>Compared as is with what the Bastion returns, including any trailing newline. Use `""` to remove the keys. |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the user should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-update-password"></a>**update_password** | `str` | `on_create` sets [`password`](#parameter-password) only when the user is created.<br>`always` sends [`password`](#parameter-password) on every run, which then always reports a change.<br><br>Choices: `always`, `on_create` (default) |
| <a id="parameter-user-auths"></a>**user_auths** | `list / elements=str` | Authentication methods of the user, for example `local_password` or `local_sshkey`. Order does not matter.<br>Required when the user does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-user-name"></a>**user_name** | `str` / required | Login of the user. Identifies the user on the Bastion.<br>The Bastion compares user names case-insensitively; a user that exists with a different case is managed as the same user and keeps its name.<br>Cannot be changed after creation. |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Ensure a local user with a password and an SSH key exists
  wallix.bastion.user:
    user_name: john.doe
    email: john.doe@example.com
    profile: user
    user_auths: [local_password, local_sshkey]
    display_name: John Doe
    password: "{{ vault_john_password }}"
    force_change_pwd: true
    ssh_public_key: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.file', 'files/john.pub') }}"
    groups: [linux-admins]

- name: Reset the password of an existing user
  wallix.bastion.user:
    user_name: john.doe
    password: "{{ vault_john_new_password }}"
    update_password: always

- name: Disable a user
  wallix.bastion.user:
    user_name: john.doe
    is_disabled: true

- name: Remove a user
  wallix.bastion.user:
    user_name: john.doe
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated. Contains `password` when [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password).<br><br>Returned: when the user already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["display_name", "groups"]` |
| <a id="return-user"></a>**user** | `dict` | The user as returned by the Bastion API after the change, without the password.<br>In check mode, the expected user. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-user) |

### Sample of `user`

```yaml
  john@laptop
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/users/john.doe

- local_password
- local_sshkey
user_name: john.doe
```
